basic_profile.bio: I'm a lifelong Ohioan and a tech enthusiast working as a network engineer. I spend my weekends either on the paintball field or tinkering with vintage computers. I'm a night owl, often online during the late hours, balancing time between work and my hobbies. Married to a fellow tech geek, we often explore the world of retro gaming together. I dislike cluttered user interfaces and slow internet speeds.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science from Kent State University, my journey into technology began early. I have a deep-seated passion for networking and cybersecurity, honed through years of self-study and professional experience. My interest in paintball developed as an extension of my love for strategic outdoor activities.
